messages:
Maya Chen: Quick thread for Integrator Summit — we need to lock ticketing feed, VIP pass counts, and the demo-kit handoff plan with Nova Systems + BlueRack.
Ethan Park: Got it. How many VIP/check-in QR codes should we allocate per partner?
Lina Gomez: Can we sync on Eventbrite CSV export? Need final list 72h before show for pre-printed badges.
Maya Chen: Suggestion: Nova gets 8 VIPs, BlueRack 5. Add a 10% buffer for walk-ins. I’ll export CSV and share a link by EOD.
Samir Patel: Demo kit questions — rack footprint: 2U per node x3, total 750W peak. Need dedicated 20A circuit. Who's handling power at booth?
Maya Chen: Booth power reserved via venue ops (order #INTG-430). Confirmed 20A available. Pack list below (labeling required):
```
- 3x demo nodes (2U each)
- 1x 2U switch
- 2x power strips (20A rated)
- 3x ethernet patch cables
- 1x KVM
- shipping manifest + commercial invoice
```
partner-bot: Shipping deadline reminder: commercial invoices + CN22 (if applicable) due by 2026-05-13 17:00 PST. Use FedEx account 44-XXXX.
Lina Gomez: Swag plan: VIP tier gets hoodies + premium stickers; general booth gets sticker packs + postcards. Need size breakdown by Tue. Can partners cover hoodies or should we?
Ethan Park: BlueRack will cover 5 hoodies; Nova covers 8. We’ll cover extras up to 10.
Samir Patel: Onsite ops — proposing Samir as demo PM for morning shift, Ethan for afternoon. Need volunteer for evening teardown.
Maya Chen: @Samir Patel and @Ethan Park noted. Lina please add shifts to the event doc and tag volunteers. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=integrator-summit-demo (will update with exact times).
Lina Gomez: Will do. Also request to partners: send a 1-slide failover summary and one contact for customs handoff. Deadline: Mon 09:00 PT.
Nova Systems (via Maya Chen): Nova will send slide + customs contact by Mon.
Ethan Park: Logistics note — courier will hand off to onsite SI rep, please include printed manifest in duplicate.
Maya Chen: Final checklist: CSV -> Tue EOD; hoodies sizes by Tue noon; slides + customs contact by Mon 09:00 PT; kits shipped by Wed 17:00 PST. Any blockers?
Samir Patel: None from infra. I’ll validate power labels and bring spare cables. :white_check_mark:
Lina Gomez: I’ll coordinate volunteer schedule and badges. Adding a QR-only express lane for VIPs at check-in. :sparkles:
Maya Chen: Perfect. If no objections I’ll lock orders and ping partners with shipping instructions. :truck: :party_parrot:
